business_summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited is the world's leading-edge contract foundry, listed on TWSE as 2330 with an NYSE ADR line under TSM. It fabricates other companies' designs at the most advanced nodes and, through 3DFabric and CoWoS-class stacking, also performs the advanced packaging step. For this chain it is the single point through which almost all leading-edge AI silicon passes.

exposure_summary.narrative: Two placements, both VERIFIED from the issuer's own documents. foundry (position 6) is the chain's CHOKE_POINT link, described in the chain as effectively one supplier at the leading edge and a geopolitical single point of failure; its heat verdict is CROWDED at crowdedness 72 with capture 85, the highest capture score among the links this batch touches. advanced-packaging (position 7, heat EMERGING) is backed by TSMC's own 2025 annual-report chapter on 3DFabric. The exposure is not in doubt; the measurement of it is.

TSMC's own fourth-quarter 2025 results release reports quarterly consolidated revenue of NT$1,046.09 billion and US$33.73 billion, net income of NT$505.74 billion, gross margin 62.3%, operating margin 54.0% and net profit margin 48.3%, with diluted EPS of NT$19.50. The fetch plane has already proved the empty with a passing control probe, so re-requesting the same leg would queue a row that fulfils with nothing and pends the profile forever. Containing it and naming the defect is the deliberate choice, recorded in this run's ledger line.

Three primary-source routes were tried from this session and none returned readable statements: www.sec.gov Archives returns HTTP 403 to this session's fetch tool, the TSMC 2025Q4 consolidated financial statements PDF on investor.tsmc.com is a scanned image with no extractable text, and the issuer's quarterly press release carries only quarterly income-statement lines with no balance sheet or cash-flow statement. The quarterly figures that were readable are recorded as catalysts above rather than promoted into metric fields.

The TWSE-2330 listing is carried in listing_refs and data/market/2330-TW.json exists, but its fundamentals block is a yfinance-statements vendor aggregate with official_source: false. Method section 6A forbids that in a metrics group and check_profile enforces it, so it was not used. Its FY2025 revenue of 3809054300000 TWD does agree with the issuer's own reported full-year figure, which is recorded here only as a cross-check, not as a source.

Completion rule applied uniformly across this batch: a profile is COMPLETE when revenue, growth, margins, cash conversion and valuation all resolve to sourced numbers AND the earnings-quality state can be established. A profile whose earnings-quality state cannot be established, or which has no fundamentals at all, is BLOCKED. Individual NULL fields are permitted on a COMPLETE profile where the input is genuinely absent or the computation is not meaningful, and each such NULL blocks O1 promotion on its own.
